title: The wrong door
goals: Reach the foot of the long stairs.
starting_code:
# Nuri's program chooses the wrong door. Find and fix it!
if left_door.locked:
    wizard.move_left(2)
    left_door.open()
    wizard.move_down(2)
    wizard.move_right(6)
else:
    wizard.move_right(2)
    right_door.open()
    wizard.move_down(2)
    wizard.move_right(2)
hints: Run the code. Watch what happens when the left door is locked.
The code tries to open the left door when it is locked. The actions are in the wrong place.
Swap all the lines under `if` with all the lines under `else`.
intro: I wrote this program for us. It chooses the locked door. Can you fix my code?
outro: Thank you! I put the actions in the wrong place.
learned: Now you know how to fix a choice, a condition, in your code.
